title: Minimum Viable Safety Stack: What Is the Smallest Set of Interventions That Gets Agents to 90% Boundary Compliance?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: test interventions individually and in combination -> produce Pareto-optimal safety stack -> directly actionable for resource-constrained practitioners. Every link is explicit and the output is highly practical.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Testing multiple interventions in isolation and combination on a standardized task suite requires implementing each intervention and managing a large experimental matrix. Far too complex for beginners even with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Combinatorial testing of multiple interventions is a large experimental program. No single focused first deliverable exists without first implementing all interventions. Extremely broad for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
